method: Nine native in-app-browser screenshots, every final WebP on white, black and actual grass-main-a; large view plus32/48/64CSSpx previews. Rechecked after final technical crop.
limitations: 52-degree elevation is a requested artistic camera cue, not a measured projection guarantee. Final camera/style/scale acceptance belongs to in-game review.
Pivot is a visible bottom-centre placement anchor; leaves can hide the botanical root. It is not a 3D measured root coordinate.
Small CSS previews are image-readability checks, not iPad/PWA/FPS or gameplay acceptance.

assets.name: tuft-card-a
assets.note: Upright fan with two cream daisies; clean transparent silhouette, no cast shadow/base. Grass and flowers readable at48/64px; at32px a small light-green tuft with pale accents.

assets.name: tuft-card-b
assets.note: Low right-leaning tuft with two yellow flowers; distinct wide silhouette, clean alpha, no base or cast shadow. Yellow accents less separated from grass at32px, still natural meadow filler.

assets.name: tuft-card-c
assets.note: Fuller left-leaning tuft with two pale pink flowers; clean alpha, no base/shadow. Pink accents subtle at32px; shape remains readable.

assets.name: flower-card-b

assets.name: flower-card-c

assets.name: flower-card-d
